import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'C:/Users/agent/xarray')
import xarray as xr
import xarray.core.weighted as W
from xarray.core.computation import dot as real_dot


def logging_dot(*args, **kwargs):
    for i, a in enumerate(args):
        print(f"    dot arg{i}: dtype={a.dtype} values={a.values.ravel()}")
    print(f"    dot kwargs: {kwargs}")
    r = real_dot(*args, **kwargs)
    print(f"    dot -> dtype={r.dtype} values={r.values}")
    return r


W.dot = logging_dot

print("=== MCVE: float data, bool weights")
dta = xr.DataArray([1., 1., 1.])
wgt = xr.DataArray(np.array([1, 1, 0], dtype=bool))
print("  mean:", dta.weighted(wgt).mean().values)
print("  sow :", dta.weighted(wgt).sum_of_weights().values)

print("=== bool data, bool weights")
d2 = xr.DataArray(np.array([True, True, False]))
m = d2.notnull()
print("  mask:", m.values, m.dtype)
print("  mean:", d2.weighted(wgt).mean().values)
print("  sow :", d2.weighted(wgt).sum_of_weights().values)

print("=== float data with NaN, bool weights")
d3 = xr.DataArray([1., np.nan, 1.])
w1 = xr.DataArray(np.array([1, 1, 1], dtype=bool))
print("  mean:", d3.weighted(w1).mean().values)
print("  sow :", d3.weighted(w1).sum_of_weights().values)
